name: Chicken Ranch Pita Pizza with Corn, Spicy Honey & Romaine Salad

instructions.primary_message: Place chickens on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces, place in a medium bowl, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chickens rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Place corn in a colander and run under hot water (from the tap) to defrost.
Divide pitas between two baking sheet pans; spread evenly with dressing, then sprinkle with cheese.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 whole grain pitas
⅓ cup ranch dressing
¾ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Top pitas with chicken, corn, and more cheese.
instructions.secondary_message: ¾ cup shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until pita pizzas are golden and cheese is melted 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, place honey and hot sauce in a clean small bowl; stir to combine and set aside.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ green bell peppers
3 hearts romaine hearts
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers lengthwise into thin strips; place in a large bowl.
Chop or tear romaine into bite-sized pieces; add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl along with additional dressing and salt; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ranch dressing
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: When the pizzas are done, remove from oven and drizzle with spicy honey; cut into wedges.
To serve, divide pizzas and salad between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
